depth_convention: camera Z-axis depth; backprojection = unit_ray * depth_z / unit_ray_z
target_depth_comparison: absolute difference between target depth_z and transformed point Z

official_source.description: Depth along the camera frame's z-axis, clamped from 0-100 millimeters; values are linearly scaled and encoded as a 16-bit grayscale image.

random_configuration.point_sampling: uniform without replacement over positive-depth pixels
random_configuration.pair_selection: deterministic evenly spaced starts via numpy.linspace

interpretation: Depth-warp diagnostic only. It does not select a convention or independently validate translation without cross-frame correspondences.
